readings.title: The River of Life
readings.subtitle: Water flows from the threshold of the House, healing the Dead Sea.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 47:1] And <dn>he</dn> turned me back to the door of the House. And look, water was flowing from under the threshold of the House toward the east, for the House faced east, and the water was flowing from under the right side of the House, from the south of the slaughter-place. [2] And <dn>he</dn> led me out by way of the north gate, and took me round on the outside to the outer gate facing east. And look, water trickling out on the right side. [3] As the man went out to the east with the line in his hand, <dn>he</dn> measured one thousand cubits, and <dn>he</dn> made me pass over into water, water to the ankles. [4] And <dn>he</dn> measured one thousand and made me pass over into water, water to the knees. And <dn>he</dn> measured one thousand and made me pass over, water to the loins. [5] And <dn>he</dn> measured one thousand, a stream that <dn>I</dn> was unable to pass over, for the water had risen, water to swim, a stream that is not passed over. [6] And <dn>he</dn> said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” And <dn>he</dn> led me and brought me back to the bank of the stream. [7] When <dn>I</dn> returned, then look, along the bank of the stream were very many trees on one side and the other. [8] And <dn>he</dn> said to me, <dq>“These waters are flowing toward the eastern country, and go down into the Araḇah, and enter the sea, being made to flow into the sea, and the waters shall be healed.</dq> [9] <dq>“And it shall be that every swarming creature, wherever the stream goes, shall live. And there shall be very many fish, for these waters shall go there, and they are healed. And wherever the stream flows all shall live.</dq> [10] <dq>“And it shall be that fishermen stand along it, from Ěn Geḏi to Ěn Eḡlayim, being places for spreading their nets. Their fish is to be of the same kind as the fish of the Great Sea, very many.</dq> [11] <dq>“Its swamps and marshes shall not be healed, they shall be given over to salt.</dq> [12] <dq>“And by the bank of the stream, on both sides, grow all kinds of trees used for food, whose leaves do not wither and fruit do not fail. They bear fruit every new moon, because their water flows from the set-apart place. And their fruit shall be for food, and their leaves for healing.”</dq>

readings.title: Borders of the Promised Land
readings.subtitle: The inheritance is divided equally, including for the sojourning stranger.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 47:13] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“This is the border by which you inherit <dn>את</dn> the land, according to the twelve tribes of Yisra’ěl, two portions for Yosěph.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall inherit it, each one the same as his brother. For <dn>I</dn> lifted <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath to give it to your fathers, and this land shall fall to you as your inheritance.</dq> [15] <dq>“And this is the border of the land on the north: from the Great Sea, the way of Ḥethlon, as one goes to Tseḏaḏ,</dq> [16] <dq>"Ḥamath, Běrothah, Siḇrayim, which is between the border of Dammeseq and the border of Ḥamath, Ḥatsar Hattiḵon, which is on the border of Ḥavran.</dq> [17] <dq>“And the border shall be from the Sea to Ḥatsar Ěnan, the border of Dammeseq, and on the north toward the north is the border of Ḥamath. This is the north side.</dq> [18] <dq>“And the east side is from between Ḥavran, and Dammeseq, and Gil‛aḏ, and the land of Yisra’ěl; the Yarděn, from the border to the eastern side of the sea you are to measure. This is the east side.</dq> [19] <dq>“And the south side toward the South is from Tamar to the waters of Meriḇah by Qaḏěsh, along the Wadi to the Great Sea. This is the south side toward the South.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the west side is the Great Sea, from the border to the point opposite Ḥamath. This is the west side.</dq> [21] <dq>“And you shall divide <dn>את</dn> this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [22] <dq>“And it shall be that you divide it by lot as an inheritance for yourselves, and for the strangers who sojourn in your midst and who bear children among you. And they shall be to you as native-born among the children of Yisra’ěl – with you they have an inheritance in the midst of the tribes of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [23] <dq>“And it shall be that in whatever tribe the stranger sojourns, there you give him his inheritance,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Northern Portions
readings.subtitle: From Dan in the far north down to Judah.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 48:1] “And these are the names of the tribes: From the north end along the way to Ḥethlon at the entrance of Ḥamath, to Ḥatsar Ěnan, the border of Dammeseq northward by the side of Ḥamath, from its east to its west side, Dan: one. [2] “And by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west, Ashěr: one. [3] “And by the border of Ashěr, from the east side to the west, Naphtali: one. [4] “And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west, Menashsheh: one. [5] “And by the border of Menashsheh, from the east side to the west, Ephrayim: one. [6] “And by the border of Ephrayim, from the east side to the west, Re’uḇěn: one. [7] “And by the border of Re’uḇěn, from the east side to the west, Yehuḏah: one.

readings.title: The Sacred Contribution
readings.subtitle: The portions for the priests, Levites, the city, and the prince.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 48:8] “And by the border of Yehuḏah, from the east side to the west, is the contribution which you offer up, twenty-five thousand cubits in width, and in length the same as one of the portions, from the east side to the west, with the set-apart place in its midst. [9] “The contribution that you offer up to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. [10] “And of these is the set-apart contribution for the priests: on the north twenty-five thousand cubits, and on the west ten thousand in width, and on the east ten thousand in width, and on the south twenty-five thousand in length. And the set-apart place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be in its midst – [11] for the priests of the sons of Tsaḏoq, who are set-apart, who did guard <dn>My</dn> Charge, who did not go astray when the children of Yisra’ěl went astray, as the Lěvites went astray. [12] “So this contribution shall be to them, from the contribution of the land, a most set-apart place by the border of the Lěvites. [13] “And alongside the border of the priests, the Lěvites have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width, its entire length is twenty-five thousand and its width ten thousand. [14] “And they do not sell any of it, nor exchange it, nor transfer this best part of the land, for it is set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [15] “And the five thousand cubits in width that is left, facing the twenty-five thousand, is for common use by the city, for dwellings and open land. And the city shall be in its midst. [16] “And these are its measurements: the north side four thousand five hundred cubits, and the south side four thousand five hundred, and the east side four thousand five hundred, and the west side four thousand five hundred. [17] “And the open land of the city shall be: to the north two hundred and fifty cubits, and to the south two hundred and fifty, and to the east two hundred and fifty, and to the west two hundred and fifty. [18] “And the rest of the length, alongside the contribution of the set-apart portion, is ten thousand cubits to the east and ten thousand to the west. And it shall be alongside the contribution of the set-apart portion, and its increase shall be food for the workers of the city. [19] “And the workers of the city, from all the tribes of Yisra’ěl, shall till it. [20] “The entire contribution is twenty-five thousand cubits by twenty-five thousand cubits, foursquare. You are to offer up the set-apart contribution with the possession of the city. [21] “And the rest is for the prince, on one side and on the other of the set-apart contribution and of the possession of the city, facing the twenty-five thousand cubits of the set-apart contribution as far as the eastern border, and westward facing the twenty-five thousand as far as the western border, alongside the portions of the prince. And the set-apart contribution, and the set-apart place of the House shall be in its midst. [22] “So the possession of the Lěvites and the possession of the city are in the midst of what belongs to the prince – between the border of Yehuḏah and the border of Binyamin, it belongs to the prince.

readings.title: The Southern Portions
readings.subtitle: From Benjamin down to Gad at the southern border.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 48:23] “As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west side, Binyamin: one. [24] “And by the border of Binyamin, from the east side to the west side, Shim‛on: one. [25] “And by the border of Shim‛on, from the east side to the west side, Yissasḵar: one. [26] “And by the border of Yissasḵar, from the east side to the west side, Zeḇulun: one. [27] “And by the border of Zeḇulun, from the east side to the west side, Gaḏ: one. [28] “And by the border of Gaḏ, on the south side toward the South, the border shall be from Tamar to the waters of Meriḇah by Qaḏěsh, along the Wadi to the Great Sea. [29] “This is the land which you divide by lot as an inheritance among the tribes of Yisra’ěl, and these are their portions,” declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Gates of the City
readings.subtitle: The city is named 'YeHoVaH is there'.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 48:30] “And these are the exits of the city, the gates of the city according to the names of the tribes of Yisra’ěl: On the north side, measuring four thousand five hundred cubits, [31] the three gates northward: one gate for Re’uḇěn, one gate for Yehuḏah, one gate for Lěvi. [32] “And on the east side, four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates: one gate for Yosěph, one gate for Binyamin, one gate for Dan. [33] “And on the south side, measuring four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates: one gate for Shim‛on, one gate for Yissasḵar, one gate for Zeḇulun. [34] “And on the west side, four thousand five hundred cubits with their three gates: one gate for Gaḏ, one gate for Ashěr, one gate for Naphtali. [35] “All around: eighteen thousand cubits. And the name of the city from that day is: <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is there!”

readings.title: Egypt, the Reward for Babylon
readings.subtitle: Nebuchadnezzar is given Egypt for his service against Tyre.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 29:17] And it came to be in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the new moon, that the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [18] <dq>“Son of man, Neḇuḵaḏretstsar sovereign of Baḇel made his army to serve a great service against Tsor, every head was made bald and every shoulder worn bare. But he and his army received no reward from Tsor, for the service he served against it.</dq> [19] <dq>“Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, ‘See, <dn>I</dn> am giving <dn>את</dn> the land of Mitsrayim to Neḇuḵaḏretstsar sovereign of Baḇel. And he shall take away her wealth, take her spoil, and remove her pillage. And it shall be a reward for his army.</dq> [20] <dq><dn>I</dn> have given him <dn>את</dn> the land of Mitsrayim as a reward for his labour, because they worked for <dn>Me</dn>,’</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] <dq>In that day <dn>I</dn> shall make the horn of the house of Yisra’ěl to spring forth, while <dn>I</dn> open your mouth to speak in their midst. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Day of YeHoVaH is Near
readings.subtitle: A sword shall come upon Egypt and her allies.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 30:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, [2] <dq>“Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Howl, ‘Woe to the day!’</dq> [3] <dq>“For the day is near, even the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is near. It is a day of clouds, the time of the nations.</dq> [4] <dq>“The sword shall come upon Mitsrayim, and great anguish shall be in Kush, when the slain fall in Mitsrayim, and they take away her wealth, and her foundations are broken down.</dq> [5] <dq>“Kush, and Put, and Luḏ, all the mixed people, and Kuḇ, and the sons of the land of the covenant, shall fall with them by the sword.”</dq> [6] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Those who lean on Mitsrayim shall fall, and the pride of her power shall come down. From Miḡdol to Sewěněh those within her shall fall by the sword,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [7] <dq>“They shall be ruined amidst the wasted lands, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are dried up.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> have set a fire in Mitsrayim and all her helpers are crushed.</dq> [9] <dq>“On that day messengers shall go forth before <dn>Me</dn> in ships to make the complacent Kushites afraid, and great anguish shall come upon them, as on the day of Mitsrayim – for look, it is coming!”</dq>

readings.title: The Ruthless Ones of the Nations
readings.subtitle: Nebuchadnezzar will destroy the idols and cities of Egypt.
readings.text: [Ezekiel 30:10] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall cause the crowd of Mitsrayim to cease, by the hand of Neḇuḵaḏretstsar sovereign of Baḇel.</dq> [11] <dq>“<dn>He</dn> and his people with <dn>את</dn> him, the ruthless ones of the nations, are brought to destroy the land. And they shall draw their swords against Mitsrayim, and shall fill <dn>את</dn> the land with the slain.</dq> [12] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make the rivers dry, and <dn>I</dn> shall sell <dn>את</dn> the land into the hand of evil ones. And <dn>I</dn> shall lay the land waste, and all that is in it, by the hand of foreigners. <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have spoken.”</dq> [13] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall destroy the idols, and make an end of the images in Noph, and there shall no longer be a prince from the land of Mitsrayim, and <dn>I</dn> shall put fear in the land of Mitsrayim.</dq> [14] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make Pathros a waste, and <dn>I</dn> shall set fire to Tso‛an, and <dn>I</dn> shall execute judgments in No.</dq> [15] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall pour out <dn>My</dn> wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Mitsrayim. And <dn>I</dn> shall cut off <dn>את</dn> the crowd of No.</dq> [16] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall set a fire in Mitsrayim, Sin shall writhe in anguish, No is to be split open, and Noph has adversaries daily.</dq> [17] <dq>“The young men of Aven and Pi Ḇeseth shall fall by the sword, while these cities go into captivity.</dq> [18] <dq>“And in Teḥaphneḥes the day shall be darkened, when <dn>I</dn> shatter the yokes of Mitsrayim there. And the pride of her strength shall cease in her, a cloud shall cover her. And her daughters shall go into captivity.</dq> [19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall execute judgments on Mitsrayim, and they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq>

readings.title: Jehoiachin Released from Prison
readings.subtitle: Evil-Merodach, king of Babylon, shows kindness to the exiled king of Judah.
readings.text: [2 Kings 25:27] And it came to be in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Yehoyaḵin sovereign of Yehuḏah, in the twelfth new moon, on the twenty-seventh of the new moon, that Evil-Meroḏaḵ sovereign of Baḇel, in the year that he began to reign, released <dn>את</dn> Yehoyaḵin sovereign of Yehuḏah from prison, [28] and spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the sovereigns who were with <dn>את</dn> him in Baḇel, [29] and changed his prison garments. And he ate bread continually before the sovereign all the days of his life. [30] And as his allowance, a continual allowance was given to him from the sovereign, a quota for each day, all the days of his life.

readings.title: Jehoiachin's Restoration
readings.subtitle: A parallel account of Evil-Merodach's favor toward the captive king.
readings.text: [Jeremiah 52:31] And it came to be in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Yehoyaḵin sovereign of Yehuḏah, in the twelfth new moon, on the twenty-fifth of the new moon, that Evil-Meroḏaḵ sovereign of Baḇel, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Yehoyaḵin sovereign of Yehuḏah and brought him out of prison, [32] and spoke kindly to him and set his throne above those of the sovereigns who were with <dn>את</dn> him in Baḇel. [33] So he changed his prison garments, and he ate bread continually before the sovereign all the days of his life. [34] And as for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the sovereign of Baḇel, a portion for each day until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
